name: SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics
description:
SellerMate connects your Amazon advertising and retail data to Claude so you can analyze performance and make changes in plain English.

Ask about your Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display campaigns: spend, ACOS, ROAS, impressions, clicks, search-term and targeting performance, placements, and negative targets. Go beyond ads with Seller Central retail analytics — total sales, sessions, organic-vs-ads and TACoS by ASIN, product catalog, inventory levels, orders, and Search Query Performance (SQP). Vendor Central accounts can pull vendor sales, ordered/shipped revenue, and inventory.

Take action, not just reporting: create Sponsored Products campaigns and update campaign budgets and keyword/product bids — all protected by your SellerMate account's permission and policy guardrails (bid/budget limits and optional approval) so nothing changes outside the bounds you set.

You can also upload knowledge and memory files (brand guidelines, reports, SOPs) for Claude to reference.

Who it's for: Amazon sellers, vendors, and agencies who manage advertising and retail operations and want to analyze and optimize without switching tools.

How it works: connect your SellerMate account with one-click OAuth. Access is scoped to the workspaces and Amazon accounts your SellerMate user already has, with read and write permissions enforced per account. Works with Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Cursor.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sellermate.ai/mcp/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics lists 26 MCP tools, including create_campaign, get_advertised_product_performance, get_campaign_creation_status, get_campaign_performance, get_inventory, get_knowledge_and_memory_file_content, get_marketplace_summary, get_orders_report, get_placement_performance, get_retail_product_performance, get_search_term_performance, and get_sellermate_capabilities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: SellerMate.AI — Amazon Ads & Retail Analytics is developed by SellerMate.AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
